raw_response:
I farm 30 mu here in Quzhou for 55 years now. My land is wheat-maize, same as everyone around here. I will tell you how I do it this year, same as most years with small changes.

For wheat, I plant in October after maize comes off. I use improved seed — my son buys it from the same dealer in town, costs about 3-4 yuan per jin. I plant about 15 kg seed per mu because the ground is cold by planting time and some seed won't come up. 

Before planting, I spread diammonium phosphate — one bag (50 kg) covers about 2.5 mu, that's my base fertilizer. Then in spring when wheat turns green, I put urea, maybe 15-20 kg per mu along with irrigation. Too little and the wheat looks yellow, then the harvest is small — better to put a little extra. My neighbor Old Wang tried less fertilizer two years ago and his yield dropped, I remember that.

Wheat needs water. I irrigate after planting to wet the ground, then winter water before it freezes, then green-up water in spring, then one more at jointing. Four times with the well. Pump costs money but without water wheat gives you nothing here. I expect 450 kg per mu — a good year maybe 500, bad year 400.

Pesticide — I spray once for aphids in spring, once for wheat head blight around flowering. That's two times. Sometimes I add herbicide early, but I count that separately.

For maize, I plant right after wheat harvest in June, no ploughing, just rotary tillage and drop the seed in. Hybrid seed, everyone uses hybrid now for maize, the old kinds don't yield. I use compound fertilizer as base when planting, then urea topdressing when the maize is knee-high. Nitrogen maybe 22 kg per mu total. Maize here gives 550 kg per mu normal year.

I irrigate maize 2 times if the rain is normal — once after planting, once at tasseling. If dry summer, maybe 3 times. I'll say 2. Spray for borers once, sometimes twice if I see them bad.

I have 30 mu so I put maize and wheat on all of it — double crop every year, that's how we do it here. My sons help with harvest, rest I do myself or hire a machine.
